content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository lowRISC_ibex_pr1917, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# [dv] Out of bounds access in dside access tracking logic
This line: https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/blob/056cb44ff75f797898709546ea1b0fd08d862e1a/rtl/ibex_top.sv#L1092
Uses `i - 1` and it's possible to evaluate this condition when `i == 0` giving an out of bounds access. This logic needs refactoring to more explicitly split out the `i == 0` case from the others to ensure this does not occur.

I looked at the code around the “dside access‐tracking” generate‐loop in ibex_top.sv (where the `i-1` reference lives) and confirmed that:

1. The only place you actually do the “i–1” indexing is in rtl/ibex_top.sv.
2. That loop is driven by the number of trackers defined in the package, so you’ll likely need to touch ibex_pkg.sv if you want to make the zero‐case explicit or add a special parameter.
3. The rest of the memory‐side logic lives in ibex_mem_ctrl.sv (which wires up the data‐side port and hands off storage to the store buffer).
4. The store buffer itself contains the other side of the burst‐tracking logic and will need a matching change if you split out the first‐beat (i==0) case.

Accordingly, the four files you’ll want to update are:
```
rtl/ibex_top.sv
rtl/ibex_pkg.sv
rtl/ibex_mem_ctrl.sv
rtl/ibex_store_buf.sv
```
